en: Vintage monochrome postcard with two framed photographs separated by ornate Art Nouveau decoration. The left image shows a crowded shoreline with many people standing in shallow water near boats, palm trees visible in the background. The right image depicts a busy pier or jetty with lines of people, some carrying luggage or goods, and ships in the harbor. Decorative floral motifs appear beneath the photos, and printed captions in Portuguese identify the location and subject.
